digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow / macOS CI pipeline
propositions: An experiment to move macOS pytest temporary trees from runner.temp to an APFS RAM disk was implemented following OSS precedent (Apple Git CI, Aeron) but was rejected after measurement showed all treatment runs were slower than the no-RAM control baseline, missing the predeclared 5% or observed-range improvement threshold.

Exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 completed the default suite in 17m26s and the macOS job in 20m36s; four independent RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) completed the same 13,397/65-skipped default in 18m43.77s, 20m54.61s, 18m26s, and 20m00.60s respectively, all slower than control.

The experiment exposed two secondary defects: intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures caused PermissionError during recursive basetemp cleanup, and nested pytest inherited a cacheprovider flag that created untracked .pytest_cache entries, both repaired in scope.

The retained fix reverts both pytest tiers to runner.temp, removes the RAM-disk setup/reporting/detach lifecycle and experiment-only workflow contract, and adds only test-local snapshot cleanup plus held-out regression tests without changing selectors, markers, workers, timeouts, platforms, coverage, or assertions.
No performance gain was achieved; recursive observability/release added 71-98 seconds of runner occupancy; filesystem latency is not the dominant constraint on the macOS pytest critical path.

All workflow parity tests (test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_extra_coverage_guard.py, test_worktree_python_pin.py) remained unchanged and passed; actionlint and zizmor checks passed; final Gerrit Verify run 31873067707 merged successfully.
